absent: Full layouts of interrupt descriptor, processor registers, redistributor region, distributor state and processor mask beyond observed fields.
Locking rules for distributor and descriptor access outside redistributor lock initialization.
System register bit definitions for completion, directory, mask, control, enable and type controls.
Translation service initialization and logical allocation flow.
Power management state machine beyond notifier restore and quiesce actions.
Hotplug teardown and error handling beyond starting and validation.
Timer and timekeeping behavior, as fragments cover interrupt control only.

findings.text: Helper irq_domain_alloc_irqs has two build variants, one forwarding to the common allocator with default hints and one unconditionally reporting failure.
Helper gic_enable_sre reports whether system register access is usable, attempting to enable it when not already set and rechecking the result.
Macros nmi_enter and nmi_exit bracket nonmaskable interrupt handling with complementary tracking for lock dependency, context state, tracing and instrumentation.
Helper GICR_TYPER_NR_PPIS derives the implemented private interrupt count from a redistributor type value.

Software generated interrupt configuration is immutable and only accepts IRQ_TYPE_EDGE_RISING, whereas shared and extended shared interrupts only accept IRQ_TYPE_LEVEL_HIGH or IRQ_TYPE_EDGE_RISING, with misconfigured private interrupts warned but tolerated.
End of interrupt handling in deactivation separated mode skips identifiers at or above the logical peripheral boundary and interrupts marked as forwarded to a virtual processor.
Identifier values in the reserved spurious range are ignored early in both normal and nonmaskable dispatch paths without further processing.

Central processing unit identity is translated from the logical map into architected affinity format by packing four affinity levels, with a quirk variant that rederives levels for a specific implementation.

Boot distributor setup starts from a disabled state, establishes nonsecure Group1 with default priorities and boot processor routing for standard and extended ranges, and finally enables with address range and Group1 controls.

Redistributor discovery validates the architecture identifier, walks each region using a configured stride or a default page skip that accounts for virtual extensions, and stops at the entry marked last.
Each processor locates its own redistributor by comparing the upper type affinity against its own affinity, recording virtual and physical bases on match and warning when no match is found.

Redistributor capabilities for virtual extensions and direct logical interrupts are combined across all entries by intersection, with boot cleanup deactivating any present virtual processor and invalidating its table, and the private count clamped to the smallest observed value.

Per processor system register setup establishes default masking and preemption behavior, selects end of interrupt mode from deactivation capability, clears active priority state appropriate to implemented bits, enables Group1, and records range selector capability.

Interprocessor signaling groups destinations by cluster, builds a single system register value from cluster affinity and target list plus the signal identifier, and orders the sequence with barriers before and after.

Affinity control rejects redistributor local interrupts, chooses first or any online processor depending on force, quiesces an enabled interrupt around routing update, and refreshes effective affinity on success.
A non symmetric configuration disables affinity and signaling operations and provides empty symmetric initialization.
Forwarding state to a virtual processor can be set or cleared for non software generated interrupts and is rejected for software generated interrupts.
Retriggering is implemented by setting the pending chip state, with the result reflecting whether the state update succeeded.
Logical interrupt support requires translation service build enablement and distributor capability indication, unless disabled by a boot option.

Per processor initialization discovers the redistributor, enables it, establishes nonsecure Group1 for local signals and privates with default priority, waits for quiescence, and initializes system registers.
System register enablement verifies access availability and reports a configuration error when disabled at a higher exception level.
A configuration without power management provides an empty processor power initialization.
Per redistributor lock rd_lock is initialized when a processor successfully matches its redistributor during discovery.
Observed redistributor region descriptor carries redist_base and phys_base and single_redist and related stride and count state used during discovery.
Observed firmware specifier carries fwnode and param_count for symmetric initialization, and observed power notifier block carries notifier_call.
The top exception entry selects a nonmaskable only path when nonmaskable support exists and the saved state shows interrupts disabled, otherwise it uses the normal interrupts enabled path.

The interrupts enabled path ensures a single acknowledgment and uses running priority to select nonmaskable versus normal dispatch, with nonmaskable handling bracketed by accounting and masked nonmaskables reenabled.
The interrupts disabled path temporarily restricts the priority mask to nonmaskable only around acknowledgment, restores the prior mask afterwards and dispatches as nonmaskable.

Completion signaling and deactivation depend on the supported mode and identifier class, with priority drop separated from deactivation when supported and combined otherwise, and unhandled cases explicitly deactivated after a warning.
Exception entry gic_handle_irq is the architected interrupt entry that delegates to the appropriate enabled or disabled handling path.
Hotplug starting routine gic_starting_cpu enables system register access, performs per processor initialization, and initializes the translation service when logical interrupts are supported.
Validation routine gic_check_rdist rejects processors whose redistributor is recorded as broken.
Power management notifier gic_cpu_pm_notifier restores redistributor and system register state on exit or failed entry, and quiesces group enable and redistributor on entry when security is disabled.
A specific implementation erratum requires explicit active clear with ordering enforcement instead of the normal completion or directory path.
Dispatch failures for unexpected normal or nonmaskable interrupts trigger a one time warning and explicit deactivation of the unhandled identifier.
Mismatched range selector support between processors and distributor, and extended ranges without processor extension support, are reported as critical configuration errors.
The identifier boundary for logical peripheral interrupts is 8192, with lower values using directory deactivation and higher values skipped in separated mode.
The reserved spurious identifier range spans 1020 through 1023 inclusive.
Standard shared interrupts start at 32, symmetric initialization registers 8 signals, and interprocessor signaling rejects identifiers at or above 16.
The redistributor type encodes private count in a five bit field with base 16, extended by 32 for encoding 1 and by 64 for encoding 2.
